exact_call_rule.positional: Each scenarios.items array unpacked in order; placeholder objects are freshly prepared exact DefaultPlaceholder instances with value field equal to placeholder payload; primitive/list items retain their declared input identity.
exact_call_rule.scenario_reset: Fresh placeholders/lists per row; no constructors run.

closed_world: Only declared nodes and aliases, exact builtin kinds/source class definitions, no monkey patching, concurrent writes, metaclass callbacks, object subclasses or hidden global producers. Each scenario is independent.
